title: Physical sample storage
purpose: Review the sample’s physical retention and disposal record separately from its preserved electronic history.

items.label: Lab ID / Client sample / Client / Project
items.description: Identifies the received sample and its ownership.

items.label: Current location
items.description: Current receipt/custody location. Record transfer opens the sample’s custody-transfer form for receipt roles while undisposed.

items.label: Retain through
items.description: Laboratory-selected inclusive physical retention date, or Not set by the laboratory. No default retention policy is inferred.

items.label: Disposal hold
items.description: Active or Not active, independent of the sample receipt disposition.

items.label: Receipt disposition
items.description: Current receipt decision; Hold also blocks disposal.

items.label: Receipt record
items.description: Receipt and custody opens the full sample record.

items.label: Physically disposed at / Recorded by
items.description: Completed disposal time and recording actor, displayed only after disposal.

items.label: Method / destination / Disposal reason
items.description: Recorded disposal method, destination and reason; disposal preserves electronic records.

items.label: Physically disposed
items.description: A completed disposal event is recorded; it takes precedence over other display states.

items.label: Disposal blocked by hold
items.description: A separate disposal hold or receipt disposition Hold is active.

items.label: Retention date not set
items.description: No explicit laboratory-selected physical retention date exists.

items.label: Retention date elapsed
items.description: The selected date is before today and no hold is displayed. This alone does not authorize disposal.

items.label: Within retention date
items.description: The retention date is today or later; the sample must be retained through that date.

sections.title: Actions and history
paragraphs: All staff can read; portal accounts cannot. After physical disposal these mutation actions and transfer link are unavailable, but receipt, custody, analytical records and issued reports remain available. A date change or removing a hold never disposes automatically.

items.label: Set retention date
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators select/change an explicit physical retention date with a reason.

items.label: Change disposal hold
items.description: Receipt roles place/remove a hold with a reason; it is separate from Change disposition.

items.label: Record physical disposal
items.description: Receipt roles open the completed-disposal form. A visible action is not proof of eligibility; submission checks dates, holds, outstanding tests and preparation.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological retention-date changes, hold changes and disposal, with actor/time/reason. Date-change entries show the prior and new retention date. An empty history explains no storage decisions have been recorded.
